bed_units.name: Crater floor fractured 1
bed_units.source_desc: Massive, light-toned fractured and blocky bedrock; dark sand fills crevices and fractures

bed_units.name: Crater floor fractured 2
bed_units.source_desc: Rougher, pock-marked surface texture from small m-scale bumps and ridges

bed_units.name: Crater floor fractured rough
bed_units.source_desc: Rough on the meter-scale, boulder-producing; local relief of only a few meters

bed_units.name: Margin fractured
bed_units.source_desc: m-scale surface roughness; erosionally resistant blocks 1-5 m in diameter

bed_units.name: Delta blocky
bed_units.source_desc: Steep-sided boulder-shedding mesas, mounds and terraces; blocks of variable size

bed_units.name: Delta thinly layered
bed_units.source_desc: Stair-stepped light-toned ledges, layers <1 m, dark sand or mantling between

bed_units.name: Delta thickly layered
bed_units.source_desc: Rough-textured, erosionally resistant layers up to several meters thick

bed_units.name: Delta layered rough
bed_units.source_desc: m-thick layers with a rough surface texture

bed_units.name: Crater rim blocky
bed_units.source_desc: High-standing ridges that erode to boulders; m-scale rubbly texture

bed_units.name: Crater rim layered
bed_units.source_desc: m to sub-m layers; fracture-bounded polygons meters to tens of meters across

bed_units.name: Crater rim breccia
bed_units.source_desc: Brecciated, disrupted bedrock; blocks 10 to >100 m in diameter

bed_units.name: Crater rim rough
bed_units.source_desc: m-scale rough texture; dark sand infilling small pits

bed_units.name: Neretva Vallis layered
bed_units.source_desc: Layered outcrops with m-scale fracture-bounded polygons

surf_units.name: Aeolian bedforms, large
surf_units.source_desc: Straight-crested bedforms (megaripples); loose sand in troughs

surf_units.name: Aeolian bedforms, small
surf_units.source_desc: Recently active aeolian ripples; reticulate and polygonal patterns

surf_units.name: Undifferentiated smooth
surf_units.source_desc: Smooth unconsolidated mantling deposits of dust, sand, pebbles, cobbles

surf_units.name: Talus
surf_units.source_desc: Accumulations of m-scale boulders on slopes and below eroded outcrops

surf_units.name: Minor Cover Us
surf_units.source_desc: Unconsolidated cover over >0 to ~25% of bedrock (bedrock dominates)

sources.geology: Stack, K.M. et al. (2020) Photogeologic Map of the Perseverance Rover Field Site in Jezero Crater Constructed by the Mars 2020 Science Team. Space Sci. Rev. 216:127. doi:10.1007/s11214-020-00739-x (CC BY 4.0). Mapped at 1:5,000 on a 25 cm HiRISE basemap.
sources.ti: Edwards, C.S. & Buz, J. (2021) THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater, Mars. Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.4931348 (CC BY 4.0). 100 m/px; overlapping images offset by up to ~20 TI units.

method: Bedrock unit = dominant unit in each grid cell (rasterized at 4x). Surface cover = most hazardous cover occupying >= 25% of the cell. Unit hazard scores are Walkback assumptions based on the quoted unit descriptions, not values from the source.
